title: In a Thousand Years

full_text:
Yes, in a thousand years, they will come on wings of steam and air! The youthful inhabitants of America will fly across the great Atlantic Ocean to visit the ancient, venerable continent of Europe!

They will travel in grand aerial ships propelled through the clouds, landing first upon the emerald shores of Ireland, gazing down upon the ruins of London and the monuments of Paris. In a few days, they will cross the Alps, view the Colosseum of Rome, walk upon the Acropolis of Athens, and gaze at the ruins of Copenhagen.

A young traveler will hold a guidebook of antiquities, saying: "Here stood the kingdoms of the ancient world! Here poets sang and emperors ruled!"

They will see Europe as we look upon the pyramids of the Nile. Yet through all changes of technology and empires, the glorious achievements of human intellect, freedom, and love will remain the eternal heritage that unites mankind across millennia.
moral: Human genius soars across skies, yet the enduring monuments of history remain sacred beacons.
